title: Generational foresight is not prediction
principle: Scenarios are structured ways to think, not forecasts.
explanation: Generational foresight connects current conditions, public evidence, demographic and systems analysis, and peacebuilding knowledge to possible future capacity needs.
userFacingCaveat: Every scenario should show assumptions, caveats, and review status.

title: Baselines are not judgments
principle: Functioning society baselines are normative reference models.
explanation: They describe capacities people and institutions generally need for dignity, health, education, safety, participation, wellbeing, and recovery.
userFacingCaveat: They require local validation and should not judge communities.

title: Glass-box foresight
principle: Users should be able to inspect the assumptions.
explanation: Future cards should show assumptions, source categories, uncertainty, caveats, and what would change the analysis.
userFacingCaveat: The model is meant to be inspectable, not mysterious.
